domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers, including rewriting, regrouping, and simplifying results

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtraction.
Tag in fraction-only or mixed-number problems when denominator matching is performed on the fractional parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator unless the step's purpose is specifically denominator matching.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction to lowest terms after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible equivalent form for subtraction before the actual subtraction is carried out.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to set up mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when a fractional part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtraction so the operand is in standard or compatible form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag borrowing or regrouping after subtraction has revealed an insufficient fractional part.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion between two unlike fractions; that belongs to equalizing denominators.
Do not tag final-answer simplification or recombination.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are in compatible form, including fraction-only subtraction and subtraction of fractional parts within mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already aligned or equal.
Tag when the subtraction yields zero or a negative intermediate fractional result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of finding or creating a common denominator.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag regrouping or borrowing steps that repair an invalid fractional subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or rewritten whole-number expressions as a distinct operation from fractional subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a whole-number difference is computed alongside fraction-part work in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the whole-part result is zero or is later adjusted after regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction-only subtraction with no whole-number component.
Do not tag the borrowing step where 1 is taken from the whole part; that belongs to regrouping.
Do not tag final combination of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow one whole from the whole-number part and convert it into fractional units when the fractional subtraction cannot be completed directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative or insufficient fractional part in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as having 0 fractional part before any borrowing occurs.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination after regrouping.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Combine whole and fractional results as needed and express the answer in lowest terms and appropriate final form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms after subtraction.
Tag when a result with zero fractional part or 0 over a denominator is simplified to an integer or zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag operand rewriting before subtraction.
Do not tag subtraction operations themselves unless the step also explicitly finalizes or simplifies the answer.
Do not tag borrowing or common-denominator conversion.
